DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_Eagle:
A Pal that can easily take flight even while grasping a human. 
It is, however, prone to letting go when tired, 
which has led to the sudden demise of more than a few souls.

Lays <itemName id=|Egg| style=|Status_Keyword|/>'s when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.

DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_Eagle:
While in party, 
modifies the performance of the equipped glider.

Enables high-speed gliding and allows shooting with the right hand.
{ReferenceMsgId_GriderPerformanceUp}

Lays <itemName id=|Egg| style=|Status_Keyword|/>'s when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
